subject: REQ reshuffle and interim contractor slate — QBR alignment
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: REQ reshuffle and interim contractor slate — QBR alignment

Team —

As we bake the QBR narrative, I did a quick pass on the headcount heatmap and put together a short set of asks to keep us within our Q4 hiring commitment while still protecting critical infra and dedicated product work. Attached: headcount_heatmap_Q4_v2.xlsx and req_change_summary.pdf. Key proposals: 

- Pause two non-customer-facing UX reqs (UX-209, UX-214) and convert remaining budget to two 6-month infra contractors focused on inference runtime optimizations.
- Fast-track backfills for: SRE (REQ-377) and Model Ops (REQ-391) — both are revenue-impacting.
- Offer a role-swap: move a mid-level PM req toward a senior infra eng (internal ref: swap proposal in sheet).

Asking for quick thumbs: Laura — approve the two backfills? Karthik — feasibility on contractors covering KV cache / kernel benching? Lauren — procurement lead time for two contractors and PO threshold? Vanessa — any red flags for leadership message framing?

I want us to have an agreed plan by EOD so we can surface the adjusted numbers at the QBR prep sync.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: headcount_heatmap_Q4_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), req_change_summary.pdf (summary)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: REQ reshuffle and interim contractor slate — QBR alignment

Marcus —

Thanks for the clear ask and the attachments. Quick thoughts: 

- Approve the two backfills (SRE REQ-377 and Model Ops REQ-391). Both are in the revenue path and we've already flagged operational risk if left open.
- Fine to pause the two UX reqs as long as Product is aligned; can you loop in Product Ops for a 30-minute sign-off?
- Role-swap is OK in principle; prefer we make the change effective only after we secure the infra contractor coverage so we don't create a gap.

Small ask: can we split the heatmap into "fixed" vs "flex" hires so execs can clearly see what we consider non-negotiable? If you can, I’ll include the sheet in the QBR packet.

Laura Bennett
Head of Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 13:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: REQ reshuffle and interim contractor slate — QBR alignment

Folks —

I reviewed the proposed contractor scope. Bottom line: yes, contractors can cover the short-term velocity for kernel selection and KV cache benchmarks, but two caveats: 

1) There is a ramp of ~3 weeks for high-impact work (we should not assign them to on-call or incident response during ramp).
2) Contractors should be senior (SSE+/Principal level contractors). I can share a short statement of work and top-3 skills we need; Nora at Randstad has two candidates in flight.

If leadership wants to present this as a cost-savings move, we should include the delta between reserved headcount cost and contractor run-rate in the QBR slide — happy to supply a one-slide comparison.

Karthik
Director, Serving Runtime

On Fri, Nov 27, 2026 at 10:03 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:

> Thanks for the clear ask and the attachments...

Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: REQ reshuffle and interim contractor slate — QBR alignment

Team —

Procurement check: we can onboard two contractors under PO threshold within 5 business days if we use our expedited vendor intake (HRT-4125). I’ve opened the intake ticket and added Nora (Randstad) as a supplier contact. Next steps: 

- Marcus: finalize the 2-page SOW Karthik mentioned and confirm FTE vs contractor start dates.
- Karthik: please send the one-slide cost comparison to me and Laura by Monday so I can attach to the PO justification.
- Laura: I’ll add the fixed vs flex column to the heatmap and push an updated sheet to the QBR folder.

I approve the two backfills pending Marcus’s confirmation on role-swap timing. No objections from finance given current hiring envelope.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Procurement & Ops
Redwood Inference

Forwarded attachment references: req_change_summary.pdf
